test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The road is too busy for elderly people __that they cannot cross safely.__

options.text: that it is difficult to cross.
that it cannot be crossed properly.
that it is impossible for them to cross.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"too busy for elderly people that they cannot cross safely"** indicates that the road is very busy, making it difficult for elderly people to cross. (सड़क इतनी व्यस्त है कि बुजुर्ग लोग इसे सुरक्षित रूप से पार नहीं कर सकते)

 
 
• **Example:** The road is too busy for elderly people that they cannot cross safely.
 
 
 
• **"to cross safely" **appropriately conveys the meaning that the road's busyness prevents safe crossing for elderly people. (सड़क इतनी व्यस्त है कि इसे सुरक्षित रूप से पार नहीं किया जा सकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The road is too busy for elderly people to cross safely.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** that it is difficult to cross. (इसे पार करना मुश्किल है)

 
 
• **Example:** The road is so busy that it is difficult to cross.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** that it cannot be crossed properly. (इसे सही तरीके से पार नहीं किया जा सकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The road is so busy that it cannot be crossed properly.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** that it is impossible for them to cross. (उनके लिए इसे पार करना असंभव है)
 
 
• **Example:** The road is so busy that it is impossible for them to cross.
 
 

303:Tb06,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
